name: Nisha Kapoor
summary: Data scientist with four years designing experiments and predictive models. Recent work explores pretrained text models for classifying customer messages.

work_experience.title: Data Scientist
responsibilities_and_achievements: Built demand estimates using chronological data splits to avoid learning from future information.
Reported uncertainty and performance by customer segment rather than relying only on an overall average.
Compared a pretrained text classifier with a simpler baseline for routing customer messages.
Investigated sensitivity to rare labels, input length, and changes in the wording of incoming requests.

work_experience.title: Junior Data Scientist
responsibilities_and_achievements: Prepared training data, checked annotation disagreements, and maintained reproducible experiment notebooks.
Shared model artifacts with a separate engineering team responsible for the live service.

projects.name: Small-model study
projects.description: Adapted a pretrained text model on a modest labeled collection and compared it with examples supplied at request time. Recorded memory needs and examined mistakes on an untouched sample. Work ran as an offline experiment.
